sections.description: An ultra-lightweight, high-performance security endpoint router and login interface branding decorator. Built exclusively to keep your client handoffs fast, secure, and 100% clean.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • New - Moved configuration panel to a dedicated, standalone admin menu for easier access.
  • New - Rebuilt 2-column flexbox engine for flawless mobile responsive rendering.
  • New - Implemented strict 404 security routing to completely block unauthenticated bot traffic on legacy paths.
  • New - Added dynamic text label color pickers and visual opacity sliders.

1.0.0

  • Initial release. Deep architectural rebrand for Net Greater Technologies.
sections.installation: Upload the ngt-easy-login-customizer-1.1.0.zip package within your Plugins dashboard panel and activate it. Once activated, navigate directly to the new NGT Login Setting menu located in your left-hand admin sidebar to configure your secure endpoints and portal branding.
